summary: Full E2E verification of the Oct-2026 update pack (POS serial/IMEI search, per-unit device identity, admin bottom-nav trim, admin map-shops sheet, DP order grouping, seller status-gate). ALL GREEN. verify_oct2026_updates.py 27/27, verify_phase1_money.py 56/56, verify_phase2_returns.py 93/93 (the stale days_left assertion the previous iteration flagged is now passing — 10-min window branch handles both cases), verify_delivery_partner.py 40/40. Desktop parity confirmed for POS search + admin map-shops.
